summary: The speaker argues that while the strict 10% tithe requirement of the Old Covenant no longer applies to Christians under the New Covenant, the underlying principle of offering material possessions to God remains essential. Citing St. Irenaeus and St. John Chrysostom, the discussion emphasizes that giving should reflect an Orthodox mentality aligned with the Incarnation, challenging listeners to practice this through faith in Jesus Christ, veneration of icons, and participation in the Eucharist despite modern financial constraints.
